    "id": "VIRTUA-1.4-1",
    "section": "1.4",
    "section_title": "Product Scope",
    "text": "Padmavathi is a Multi-speciality Hospital in the Surathkal suburb of Mangalore.",

    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-1.4-2",
    "section": "1.4",
    "section_title": "Product Scope",
    "text": "The system shall provide 24/7 Primary Care at Doorstep of Patients using a panel of high quality doctors within a 25 Square Kilometers of Hospital (specified Pincode(s) - also termed as Zone).",
    "kind": "functional",
    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-1.4-3",
    "section": "1.4",
    "section_title": "Product Scope",
    "text": "The system shall provide quality medicines vide authorized Chemists located within the zone at the door-step at discounted prices.",

    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-1.4-4",
    "section": "1.4",
    "section_title": "Product Scope",
    "text": "The system shall give door-step Laboratory services wherever possible vide specimen collection.",

    "testable": true,
    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-1.4-5",
    "section": "1.4",
    "section_title": "Product Scope",
    "text": "The system shall help elderly and inform people as well as people who need regular monitoring services to get access to quality healthcare services at affordable prices at the Door-step.",

    "refs": []
  },
  {
    "id": "VIRTUA-1.4-6",
    "section": "1.4",

    "section": "1.6",
